input:
Earlier scenes:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

This scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这把花对他的身体好不好，An embedded yes/no question after “不知道” uses an A-not-A form, not “如果”; the body pronoun should also stay in the third-person narrator’s perspective.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看如果这把花毒不毒：看这把花有没有毒，In the pattern “这就要看……了”, the part after “看” must be a question form; “如果” cannot introduce an embedded A-not-A question here.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，When choosing between two specific possibilities in an embedded question, use “是……还是……”, not an A-not-A question together with “或者”.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他一吃花：他一吃这种花，Use a demonstrative plus measure word and noun for the particular flower just mentioned, rather than the generic noun “花”.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农不知道他吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃：神农不知道自己吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃，Use “自己” when the person who ate is the same person as the main subject; this makes the co-reference clear.

items.reason: “不知道如果……” is incorrect here, but “这把花” does not match the intended type-of-flower reference, for which the teacher requires “这种花.”
“如果” cannot occur before the embedded A-not-A question after “看,” and “有没有毒” correctly fixes it.
The teacher’s intended meaning is whether Shen Nong should eat it (“要不要吃”), whereas “吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃” changes this into which one he had eaten.
Bare “花” can refer back to the flower just mentioned, so the proposed reference change is unnecessary; moreover, the clause still lacks the required “就” in the 一……就…… pattern.
In this sentence, “他” already refers clearly to 神农, so replacing it with “自己” is not required.
